articles.text: José drives the Harrises around the city. They visit the business district and notice the best stores. Mrs. Harris remarks on the crowds and asks what church they see; José explains it’s the cathedral and that people have just come out of mass. Later, Jean comments on the full cafés and José jokes that it’s just an excuse to get together and talk. Finally, Jean says he’d like to see the old part of the city, but José says it’s not worth it because the streets are very narrow.

The next day, Bob and Jean plan to tour the city by car with Molina. Jean loves the idea. Bob notes that Molina just called and will come by soon. Jean wonders if Bob can ask Molina to take them to church, though Bob is sure Molina won’t like it because he never goes to mass. They discuss visiting the cathedral again and comment that the Colonel hasn’t been to a church for a long time.
